newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal debt body denies rumour of $1 bln issue.
newsitem.headline: Portugal debt body denies rumour of $1 bln issue.

text.p: The Institute of Management of Public Credit (IGCP) denied a rumour published by International Insider that Portugal was preparing a five-year bond issue for $1 billion, an official source in the institute said.
"The rumour of the five-year $1 billion issue, as published today by International Insider, is not true," the source told Reuters.

"The issues that we are planning for 1997, in accordance with the financing programme for the year, will be published in due time, when they occur," the source said. The IGCP is authorised to secure foreign loans of up to 350 billion escudos in 1997.
